question: Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e726bcfb47459aae00d4266a9b16cc0a4919705c76e6ff3b2a150a941cf33ae4.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) Every element is shifting in one place clockwise direction until the last element does not come. The last element "+" disappeared and one new element A is appeared at the last.**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ac562c61f03446186aef8ceb802e7f32dd377c5efee34b20cb2915c857ba0d7.png] 

 
• 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18d00e4d4e2743b78ab475740702ce2db1cb0c1c12e66d8c2063c330b473183f.png] 

 

2) Every element is shifting **two **places clockwise direction until the **second **last element does not come. The second last element " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/112405439703454d350b2cc1d43b815eff3f2b6f3ac00ec3c3b9dd8de0bfdbd8.png] " disappeared and one new element B is appeared at the last . As A is placed after eliminated element, A is shifting three placed clockwise direction.

 
• 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/879ae780e006e0ecfdd26924874f280957fd2fe4a666049669c971c0eaaa1fb4.png] 

3) Every element is shifting three **places clockwise direction until the **third **last element does not come. The third last element "$" disappeared and one new element C is appeared at the last . As A, B are placed after eliminated element, A, B are shifting four placed clockwise direction.

 
• **
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41744b748be0005272f049371304e950ae0a0baf239a47850a9c0b9088d834ed.png] 

4) Every element is shifting four **places clockwise direction until the **fourth **last element does not come. The third last element "≠ " disappeared and one new element D is appeared at the last . As A, B,C are placed after eliminated element, A, B,C are shifting five placed clockwise direction.

 
• 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdda0d3ecff7ae4757bc2bdacda7a9565aef46d5daa50d491eaa2c2b23fcb1a7.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (1)’ is the correct answer.
